note: Illinois DNR Hennepin Canal State Park designated camping area at Lock 22, southwest of the lift bridge: an open lawn with fire pits between the parking lot and the canal basin, and a smaller area across the lift bridge on the north side. Open to tents and RVs alike; site length not published. Drinking water only at the visitor center near Sheffield. --Claude
